title: 第3章 伪装坐化
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

骨针泛着幽幽的冷芒，在昏暗的祖祠密室里显得格外渗人。

林渊站在老祖的干瘪尸身前，深吸了一口气，将脑海中那些驳杂的邪修记忆再次过滤了一遍，锁定了其中一门极其偏门的小手段——金针刺穴。

修仙界中，高阶修士查验低阶修士的死因，通常会用神识扫过周身经脉。

若肉身残存灵力紊乱、窍穴破损，多半会被判定为走火入魔或功法反噬。

而林老祖这具肉身本就气血枯竭、大限将至，这便是最好的伪装底牌。

“老祖，既然您生前教导我要弱肉强食，那死后，就再帮孙儿最后一次吧。”

林渊面无表情，指尖灵力微动，一根骨针瞬间化作一道极细的白芒，精准地刺入了林老祖头顶的百会穴。

一声沉闷的细响。

紧接着，林渊动作不停，双手如穿花蝴蝶般掠过尸身的各大要穴。

太阳、气海、命门、涌泉……一共九根骨针，齐齐没入肉身。

这是邪修用来激发傀儡残存潜力的法门，此刻被林渊逆向运使。

随着骨针彻底封死窍穴，林老祖体内残存的、属于筑基后期修士的星星点点灵力，开始在经脉中疯狂逆流，最后在丹田处猛烈撞击。

林渊脚下一错，身形迅速后撤了三丈。

只见林老祖的面皮剧烈抽动了一下，原本灰败的面色竟然诡异地泛起一丝潮红，随后“哇”的一声，喷出一口黑红色的污血。

那是他肉体内最后一丝生机连同浑浊的淤血一同被逼出。

经脉尽断，生机彻底断绝。

林渊这才走上前去，将林老祖的尸身摆弄成了修仙界最常见的五心向天盘坐姿势。

双手交叠置于膝头，双目微闭，神态中透着一丝不甘与疯狂。

在外人看来，这分明是一位大限将至的筑基后期大修，在绝望之际尝试强行冲击金丹瓶颈，最终却落得个灵力逆流、散功反噬而亡的下场。

“大限已至，疯狂博取一线生机，这很符合一个自私邪修的做派。”

林渊低语，对自己的这手布置颇为满意。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The bone needles glowed with a faint cold light, which seemed particularly penetrating in the dark secret room of the ancestral temple.

Lin Yuan stood in front of the ancestor's shriveled corpse, took a deep breath, filtered through the mixed memories of evil cultivators in his mind, and locked on one of the extremely unsophisticated methods - golden needle acupoints.

In the world of cultivating immortals, when high-level monks examine the cause of death of low-level monks, they usually use their spiritual consciousness to scan the meridians around their bodies.

If the remaining spiritual energy in the physical body is disordered and the acupoints are damaged, it will most likely be judged as an obsession or a backlash from the skill.

And Patriarch Lin's physical body is already exhausted and his end is approaching, so this is the best disguise card.

"Ancestor, since you taught me to eat the weak and the strong before you were alive, then after you die, I will help my grandson one last time."

Lin Yuan's face was expressionless, and his fingertips moved slightly with spiritual power. A bone needle instantly turned into a very fine white light and accurately penetrated the Baihui point on the head of Patriarch Lin.

A dull, thin sound.

Immediately afterwards, Lin Yuan kept moving, his hands passing over the major points of the body like butterflies passing through flowers.

The sun, the sea of ​​​​qi, the gate of life, the spring...a total of nine bone needles were all submerged into the physical body.

This is a method used by evil cultivators to stimulate the remaining potential of puppets, and it is now being used in reverse by Lin Yuan.

As the bone needles completely sealed the acupoints, the bits and pieces of spiritual power that remained in Patriarch Lin's body and belonged to the late-stage foundation-building monks began to flow crazily in the meridians, and finally hit the Dantian violently.

Lin Yuan made a mistake and quickly retreated three feet.

Ancestor Lin's face twitched violently, and his originally gray complexion turned strangely red. Then with a "wow" sound, he spurted out a mouthful of black and red blood.

That was the last trace of life in his body that was forced out along with the turbid blood.

The meridians are cut off, and vitality is completely cut off.

Lin Yuan then stepped forward and arranged Patriarch Lin's body into the most common posture of sitting cross-legged with five hearts facing the sky in the world of immortality.

His hands were folded on his knees, his eyes were slightly closed, and there was a hint of reluctance and madness in his expression.

In the eyes of outsiders, this was clearly a late-stage foundation-building overhaul who was about to reach his end. He tried to break through the golden elixir bottleneck in despair, but ended up with a backflow of spiritual energy and a backlash of his energy, and he died.

"The deadline has come, and frantically trying to gain a chance of survival is very consistent with the behavior of a selfish and evil cultivator."

Lin Yuan whispered, quite satisfied with his arrangement.
